# Roadmap: Full Stack Developer

A step-by-step plan to become a Full Stack Developer, built from 11 topics in your notes. Works on both frontend and backend of an application.

> **Draft, generated from your notes.** Every item links to the note it comes from. The order of topics is a suggestion; review and adjust it.

## The role

- **What they do:** Works on both frontend and backend of an application.
- **Typical experience to be hired:** 0+ yrs
- **Technical skills:** End-to-end feature delivery, API design, DB design, Auth (OAuth/JWT), Deployment & CI/CD, Testing across layers, Debugging across stack, Basic cloud & containers
